title: Before the council
note: A short invented chat. Scored spellings are in the replaced turns. One spelling is only in the kept tail.

messages.content: The issue has to ship before the council meeting.
The cover date is 3 March 2026. The headline is Bridge vote slips. The piece runs on page 4.
Credit the photo to Nia Holt, not to the wire.
Nia Holt gets the credit. The wire credit is withdrawn.
How do we mark a legal problem?
A blue pencil in the margin means hold the line.
I will send the flat tonight.
